name: gitlab_mr
description: Merge requests of the repo's GitLab project. list (allProjects: every project; next = more pages), get, status (pipeline, approvals, discussions, conflicts, blockers), diff, commits, create (draft by default), update, approve, unapprove, rebase, merge (only when the user asks; iid and head sha required; refused for drafts, conflicts, blocking discussions, release* or protected targets besides main/master/develop unless allowProtectedTarget). Labels must exist unless createMissingLabels. Writes on MRs by others are refused without allowOthers.

project.description: Another project path on the same host (group/project).

iid.description: MR !iid. Default: the open MR of the current branch.

sha.description: merge: full head sha from status.

allowOthers.description: Write on someone else's MR; only when the user asked.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the current workspace Git repository.

name: gitlab_mr_comment
description: Discussions of a merge request: list (ids, authors, file/line, resolved; next = more pages), unresolved (open threads: place, author, ask, last reply; up to 2,000 discussions), comment, reply to a discussion, line (a diff comment on path at line, or oldLine for a removed line), edit a note, resolve, unresolve; draft: true does these as private draft notes, drafts lists them, publish posts one (noteId) or all. Writes on MRs by others are refused without allowOthers.

project.description: Another project path on the same host (group/project).

iid.description: MR !iid. Default: the open MR of the current branch.

noteId.description: edit; publish: one draft, default all.

draft.description: comment, reply, line, edit: a draft note.

path.description: line: file path as in the diff.

oldLine.description: line: old-side line number (both for an unchanged line).

allowOthers.description: Write on someone else's MR; only when the user asked.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the current workspace Git repository.

name: gitlab_pipeline
description: Pipelines of a merge request (iid, or the current branch's MR) or of a ref: list; jobs of a pipeline (default the latest) with downstream pipelines; wait for one to end (at most minutes; failed jobs with log excerpts); run (an MR pipeline, or a ref pipeline with variables); retry or cancel a job or pipeline; play a manual job; artifacts of a job (names, sizes, URL). Read a failed job with gitlab_job_log.

project.description: Another project path on the same host (group/project).

iid.description: MR !iid. Default: the open MR of the current branch.

ref.description: Branch or tag instead of an MR.

minutes.description: wait: at most this long (default 10, max 30).

allowOthers.description: Write on someone else's MR; only when the user asked.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the current workspace Git repository.

name: gitlab_job_log
description: A CI job's log without terminal codes. errors (default): lines matching error words or pattern, with context, then the last 30 lines; tail: the last lines; full: everything, cut at 60k characters.

project.description: Another project path on the same host (group/project).

pattern.description: errors: a case-insensitive regex instead of the error words.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the current workspace Git repository.

name: gitlab_label
description: Labels of the current repo's GitLab project (its own and its groups'): list (name, colour, description; search; next = more pages); create (name, color default #428BCA, description), which answers the existing label when the name is taken.

project.description: Another project path on the same host (group/project).

workspace.description: Absolute path to the current workspace Git repository.

name: gitlab_user
description: A user of the current repo's GitLab host: the token's own user by default (or @me), else the one with username.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the current workspace Git repository.
